site_name: Havering College of Further and Higher Education
description: Details Pursuant to Conditions 19 (Contamination Verification Report), 22 (Play Areas), 28 (Landscape & Boundaries), 31 (Travel Plan), 40 (Secured by Design), 43 (Highway Access), 44 (Parking management Plan), 46 (Car Parking Provision) and 52 (Cycle Storage) of Planning Permission P0384.25 Dated 31-07-25 for Variation of condition No. 2 (in accordance with the approved plan): for elevational changes to the residential blocks; condition No. 8 (M4(2) 'accessible and adaptable dwellings'): changes to approved parking layout and variation of wording of the condition; and relocation of substation, of planning permission ref: P0883.20 dated 01/02/2022 (Demolition of existing buildings and redevelopment of the site to provide 120 residential dwellings comprising 78 houses and 42 flats(1bed x 12, 2bed x 53, 3bed x 55) with associated car parking, landscaping, open space, play space and infrastructure).
